notes.title: Update Released: Bug Fix, Relaxed Gameplay, and Steam Cloud Save Setup
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’ve just released a new update for Slide Treasures: Lydia's Hunt that addresses a minor bug and introduces some adjustments to make your gameplay experience even more enjoyable. Additionally, we’ve set up Steam Cloud Save to ensure your progress is safely backed up.

Additionally, we would like to apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused. As part of the Cloud Save setup, there is a chance some players may lose their current save files. We understand this can be frustrating, but we felt it was important to implement this feature sooner rather than later to prevent any potential disruptions as you progress further in the game.

Thank you for understanding and for your support.

Happy gaming!

Best regards,
LUMA Gameworks
